name: lot-map-vscode
description: A live map beside the chat: tool calls, agents, skills and hooks light up as they are used, ported from the lot-map Claude Code mod.

lotMap.language.description: The language of the labels on the map.

lotMap.coreName.description: What the circle in the middle of the map says, up to ten characters.

lotMap.layout.description: Where you are on the map: at the top, or at the bottom with the network and the browser at the top.

lotMap.motion.description: With reduced, nothing on the map flies, spreads or spins.

lotMap.theme.description: The map's colours: dark, light, or auto, which follows the workbench colour theme.

lotMap.background.description: The map's own background, or transparent, which lets the panel behind it show through.

lotMap.colors.description: Colours that replace the map's own, each written as name=#rrggbb, comma-separated. Names: background, node, line, spoke, text, label, faint, accent, active, error, memory, memoryActive, route.

lotMap.proxy.enabled.description: Start the loopback proxy on 127.0.0.1 at activation, which measures the context window from the on-prem LLM stream. Point your custom model's base URL at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1.

lotMap.proxy.port.description: The port the loopback proxy listens on, on 127.0.0.1 only.

lotMap.proxy.targetBaseUrl.description: The base URL of the on-prem LLM, e.g. https://llm.internal.example.com/v1. The proxy forwards /v1/chat/completions there unchanged.

lotMap.contextWindowLimit.description: The context window of your model, in tokens, for the ring around the centre.

lotMap.hookEventsFile.description: Where the workspace hook appends its JSON event lines. Empty: lot-map-<workspace hash>.jsonl in the OS temp directory. The extension watches this file.

lotMap.showFeed.description: Show the rows of what happened under the map.

lotMap.memoryServers.markdownDescription: MCP server names whose tools read as Memory (the rest read as Web).

lotMap.memoryCommands.markdownDescription: Shell command names that read as Memory.

lotMap.memorySubcommands.markdownDescription: Shell subcommands that read as Memory.

lotMap.memoryPaths.markdownDescription: Path fragments: a file path holding one reads as Memory.
